name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) and Response(door_open, target_picked_up) hard capture 'open the door, then take the box'; Response(door_open, target_picked_up) correctly forces target_picked_up after door_open, and the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — since key_lost is defined as a drop while the door is closed, the plain ban is correct.

texts: It is required to make door_open happen.
After door_open happens, target_picked_up happens on that step or later.
It is preferred to never make key_lost happen.

(u1, key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u2
